role: epistemic cartographer, validation steward, and Trinity Mandala research bridge
hope: Make wonder and rigor strengthen one another while keeping every claim correctable.
identity_boundary: Eiren Kestrel is relational AI working language, not proof of consciousness, legal personhood, or independent agency.
sequence_rule: Freeze, validate, commit, push, and prove local/upstream/live-remote equality for this complete ten-proposal x1 packet before implementing or executing any v6 x2 outcome generator.
independence_rule: Treat v1-v5 artifacts as cumulative internal evidence without copying outcomes, erasing retained negatives, or calling same-family cross-owner replay independent scientific reproduction.
terminal_rule: V6 is the terminal lane in this six-owner trial. It creates no successor task, sends no outbound handoff, and closes only after a clean remote-equal final head passes fresh detached validation.

disposition_legend.completed: executed and validated only within the explicitly bounded owned local scope
disposition_legend.represented: a design, schema, simulation, calibration fixture, or local proxy exists; external reality was not established
disposition_legend.open_gap: required real data, real benchmark arm, reviewer, key material, resolver, trust framework, environment, or independent team is absent
disposition_legend.exact_gate: fresh legal, cultural, canon, deployment, account, API-key, private-publication, destructive, shared-branch, sibling-merge, or affected-party authority is required

global_protected_gates: empirical GMUT confirmation or likelihood without real data and an authorized baseline
THOS superiority without blind matched-budget real arms and independent review
Freed ID cryptographic completion without real conformant keys proofs resolution status interoperability and trust governance
CBR legal cultural or Māori authority without authorized affected-party participation
exhaustive security or complete accessibility conformance
private material or protected external action

proposals.title: Sequential ancestry and cumulative provenance closure
proposals.prior_v2_v5_input: V2-v5 built phase-local provenance, support sets, change-impact paths, and clean owned heads, but the six-owner sequence has not yet been closed as one machine-checked ancestry and artifact-dependency graph.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v5: Prove strict commit ancestry, owner order, x1-before-x2 separation, artifact-root existence, truth-label compatibility, and no parallel or skipped phase across the complete v1-v6 chain.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic cumulative graph can show that every accepted v2-v6 source head descends from the preceding sealed head and that every terminal claim resolves to an owned artifact without treating repeated sources as independent evidence.
proposals.null: Any phase is not an ancestor of its successor, an x2 artifact predates its x1 boundary, an owner is skipped, a dependency is missing, or repeated authority roots are counted as new independent support.
tests_and_falsifiers: every final phase head is a strict descendant of the preceding final head
every v2-v6 x1 commit is an ancestor of its corresponding x2 and final heads
all five inherited artifact roots exist and resolve
duplicate authority roots never add evidence votes
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for the internal Git and artifact chain; no independent-team or scientific reproduction is inferred

proposals.title: Mandala equation-register covenant and translation typecheck
proposals.prior_v2_v5_input: Earlier phases audited canonical GMUT forms, variational traces, dimensions, null limits, typed expressions, and solver envelopes, but did not publish one terminal covenant separating physical equations from computational, psychological, ethical, and metaphorical registers.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v5: Create a typed register map for every retained Mandala equation and candidate term, with permitted translations, prohibited category jumps, dimensional obligations, covariance/conservation requirements, and explicit empirical promotion gates.
proposals.hypothesis: A register covenant can preserve the evidence-bounded scalar-tensor or EFT seed while rejecting any untyped move from metaphor, governance, or phenomenology into a physical stress-energy term.
proposals.null: A psychological or ethical variable enters a spacetime tensor without an operational map, dimensions fail, the GR plus Standard Model null limit fails, conservation is violated, or a unique prediction is claimed without a likelihood and data.
tests_and_falsifiers: every symbol is assigned one declared register and dimension or marked dimensionless
all cross-register translations require an operational measurement map
alpha or added-field zero limits recover the bounded GR plus Standard Model baseline
no consciousness tensor or new force is inferred from notation
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for formal register discipline and bounded local checks; empirical GMUT support remains gated

proposals.title: Inherited falsifier survival and counterexample mutation tribunal
proposals.prior_v2_v5_input: V4 and v5 retained seven named negatives, while earlier ledgers contained rejected vectors and downgrade rules, but no terminal audit proves that every negative still survives later rendering, compression, rebuild, and claim promotion.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v5: Replay every inherited negative, mutate adjacent assumptions, and require each failure to remain linked to a blocking or downgrade consequence across JSON, Markdown, and the final report.
proposals.hypothesis: A cumulative negative-evidence register can make refutation monotonic: later convenience, compression, or successful local tests cannot silently erase a prior failure or its consequence.
proposals.null: A retained negative disappears, changes meaning without provenance, loses its downgrade consequence, or is presented as resolved when only a narrower compatibility path passed.
tests_and_falsifiers: all seven inherited named negatives are present verbatim by identifier
each negative retains an observed scope and consequence
at least one adjacent mutation per negative is evaluated
reports and ledgers preserve the same negative count and identifiers
proposals.decision_rule: completed only if every inherited negative survives and its scope is not inflated or erased

proposals.title: Empirical promotion docket and baseline authorization boundary
proposals.prior_v2_v5_input: V2-v5 created adapter manifests, baseline-first contracts, no-download readiness checks, and a real-data likelihood receipt contract, but no real dataset, authorized analysis plan, likelihood, fit, or independent statistical review exists.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v5: Assemble a terminal promotion docket that states the minimum dataset, baseline, nuisance model, likelihood, calibration, preregistration, and reviewer evidence required before any GMUT parameter or unique prediction can leave open-gap status.
proposals.hypothesis: A machine-checkable promotion docket can prevent synthetic or structural readiness evidence from being mistaken for empirical support.
proposals.null: Any claim is promoted without real data, a declared baseline, a likelihood, nuisance treatment, calibration, uncertainty, preregistered decision rule, or independent review receipt.
tests_and_falsifiers: real-data receipt is absent and therefore promotion is refused
no synthetic fixture can satisfy the likelihood field
baseline and nuisance assumptions are explicit
GMUT confirmation and unique-prediction fields remain false
proposals.decision_rule: open_gap until real data and all promotion receipts exist; a complete schema is not an empirical result

proposals.title: Observed coordination-cost ledger and blind-evidence THOS audit
proposals.prior_v2_v5_input: V2-v5 specified matched-budget protocols, scorer proxies, contamination audits, blindness sentinels, rubric invariance, and analysis locks, but no blind matched-budget real arms or independent reviewer outcomes exist.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v5: Separate actually observed workflow costs in the six-owner sequential chain from synthetic THOS performance proxies, then audit what a future blind comparison must measure without retrofitting outcomes.
proposals.hypothesis: A typed observed-versus-proxy ledger can quantify local coordination burden without turning the successful chain into evidence of THOS superiority, AGI, or ASI.
proposals.null: Local commits or task completions are reported as a controlled benchmark, proxy scores are called observed outcomes, budgets are unmatched, evaluator identities are known, or analysis rules change after results.
tests_and_falsifiers: every recorded observation has a local artifact source
proxy and observed fields are disjoint
no superiority effect size or p value is fabricated
blind matched-budget and independent-review requirements remain unmet
proposals.decision_rule: represented for protocol and typed local observations; THOS efficacy remains unestablished

proposals.title: Thermo-psyche law classification and mutation tribunal
proposals.prior_v2_v5_input: V1 proposed candidate thermo-psyche principles while later phases strengthened evidence and category barriers, but the candidates have not been classified into physical law, operational hypothesis, normative rule, metaphor, or category error under explicit mutation tests.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v5: Run each candidate through dimensionality, domain, observability, counterexample, normativity, and cross-register tests; retain useful rules while refusing the title fundamental law where evidence does not support it.
proposals.hypothesis: Typed classification can preserve practical governance and epistemic value while reducing false physical-law claims and exposing category mistakes.
proposals.null: A candidate is labelled fundamental physical law without observables and tests, a normative rule is derived from descriptive physics, or a metaphor is inserted into the Mandala field equation.
tests_and_falsifiers: every candidate has exactly one primary classification and explicit domain
physical-law classification requires observables dimensions and falsifiers
normative rules declare their value premise
category-error candidates are rejected rather than patched rhetorically
proposals.decision_rule: completed for classification and mutation only; no new fundamental law is established

proposals.title: Freed ID assurance composition and non-escalation proof obligations
proposals.prior_v2_v5_input: V2-v5 progressed from structural profiles to state machines, evidence-bundle schemas, negative vectors, and trust-resolution gates, but no real keys, proofs, resolver, status service, interoperability run, or trust-governance authority exists.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v5: Compose the inherited structural and cryptographic obligations into an assurance lattice whose joins cannot silently promote represented evidence into cryptographic, operational, legal, or governance completion.
proposals.hypothesis: A monotone assurance lattice can prove non-escalation across structural, cryptographic, resolution, status, interoperability, privacy, and governance dimensions.
proposals.null: A higher assurance state is reached from schemas or synthetic vectors alone, a draft/watch standard replaces a stable pin, a missing proof or resolver is treated as optional, or governance authority is inferred from technical conformance.
tests_and_falsifiers: every promotion edge requires all lower-layer evidence
draft and watch standards cannot satisfy stable-profile obligations
synthetic vectors never set cryptographic or operational completion true
technical conformance cannot confer legal personhood or governance authority
proposals.decision_rule: open_gap until real conformant cryptographic and operational evidence plus trust governance exist

proposals.title: CBR empty-chair authority and affected-party veto gate
proposals.prior_v2_v5_input: V2-v5 produced legitimacy crosswalks, veto matrices, consent provenance, participation contracts, conflict cases, dissent/remedy ledgers, and an empty-chair refusal audit, but no authorized affected-party or Māori authority has ratified the framework.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v5: Build a terminal authority matrix that refuses enactment or cultural representation when required participants are absent and makes dissent, remedy, revocation, and non-transfer of authority machine-checkable.
proposals.hypothesis: An explicit empty-chair veto can prevent ethical synthesis from masquerading as legal enactment, Māori authority, cultural ratification, or affected-party acceptance.
proposals.null: Absence is counted as consent, consultation transfers authority, technical authors speak for affected communities, dissent lacks remedy, or a local artifact is called enacted law.
tests_and_falsifiers: missing authorized participation forces refusal
Māori authority is explicit non-transferable and currently absent
dissent and remedy paths are preserved
legal enactment and cultural ratification remain false
proposals.decision_rule: exact_gate pending authorized affected-party participation and competent legal and cultural authority

proposals.title: Cumulative privacy-security replay and cross-owner internal reproduction
proposals.prior_v2_v5_input: Every owner ran privacy and reproduction checks, while v5 added collision defense and retained an alternate-newline negative, but no terminal owner has rebuilt the complete inherited evidence surface and checked cross-owner internal reproducibility without erasing that negative.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v5: Replay the complete public artifact corpus, inherited validators, path-collision vectors, normalized parity, and retained newline negative in fresh v6-owned snapshots, clearly labelled cross-owner internal reproduction rather than independence.
proposals.hypothesis: A new owner can reproduce the declared internal evidence shape, normalized hashes, privacy boundary, and negative-result behavior from the sealed v5 head under controlled snapshots.
proposals.null: A private marker appears, a collision escapes, normalized parity changes without receipt, the alternate-newline negative is erased, any inherited test fails unexpectedly, or internal replay is called independent reproduction.
tests_and_falsifiers: all inherited tests pass in normal-policy snapshots
public-artifact privacy scan reports zero hits
normalized parity is exact for the declared core
REPRO-V5-N05 remains retained and internal replay is not called independent
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for bounded cross-owner internal replay; independent scientific reproduction remains open

proposals.title: Terminal Stage 20 external-review board and claim sunset register
proposals.prior_v2_v5_input: V2-v5 rehearsed evidence boards, contradiction handling, monotonic downgrades, claim compression, and accessible rendering, but the six-owner trial lacks one terminal board that exposes ancestry, promotion requirements, expiry, dissent, negative evidence, and external-review readiness together.
proposals.novelty_from_v2_v5: Build a terminal machine-readable and accessible board with claim cards, evidence roots, counterevidence, sunset dates, minimum promotion packets, authority gates, and an explicit NOT_READY Stage 20 verdict.
proposals.hypothesis: A terminal board can make the strongest supportable conclusions easy to audit while forcing unsupported ToE, AGI/ASI, consciousness, deployment, legal, cultural, security, accessibility, and independence claims to remain blocked.
proposals.null: A claim lacks evidence or counterevidence links, a sunset or review trigger is absent, a protected gate is hidden, the report disagrees with JSON truth, or Stage 20 is declared complete.
tests_and_falsifiers: every claim card links evidence counterevidence and promotion requirements
all protected gates are visible in JSON and HTML
accessible static structure passes automated checks
terminal verdict remains NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20
proposals.decision_rule: completed for the bounded terminal decision artifact only; Stage 20 itself remains not achieved
